Our bipartisan subpoena requires Pam Bondi to appear before our Committee, whether she's Attorney General or not.

The Oversight Committee subpoena is for Pam Bondi, whether she is the Attorney General or not. 

Former AG Bill Barr gave testimony under oath on the Epstein files, and we look forward to hearing from Bondi in two weeks. Bondi now has an opportunity to give us the full truth.

Pam Bondi and Donald Trump may think her firing gets her out of testifying to the Oversight Committee. 

They are wrong - and we look forward to hearing from her under oath.


Oversight Dems (@OversightDems)
